_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Tagata Ta'alo Surround i le laupapa {width}x{height}.
Oe o le tagata ta'alo {player_id}. Fa'ailoga e talafeagai: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' po'o w/s/a/d.
Fa'amoemoe: outlive tagata ta'alo uma. Ala o le maliu; o le tio i le pa e maliu; o le tio i le ulu e maliu uma.

board.current: Komiti Faatino o loʻo iai nei: {board}
board.after_moves: Komiti Faatino ina ua uma ona siitia i le taimi e tasi: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: O le tagata taalo {player_id} na maliu ona o se gaoioiga lē saʻo.

outcome.survived_win: O le tagata ta'alo {player_id} na ola; tagata ta'alo uma na tio.
outcome.all_crashed: Na feoti uma tagata taaalo i le taimi e tasi.
outcome.outlived: Na ola le tagata taalo i isi uma.
outcome.turn_limit: Ua oo i le tapulaa o taimi e liliu ai - ua manumalo lē na ola umi.
